entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence length is 768 aa and contains one ambiguous X residue, so some physicochemical calculations were skipped.
N-terminal region contains Pfam FAD_binding_3 hits at residues 56–97 and 310–394, plus an overlapping NAD_binding_8 hit at 60–92.
C-terminal region contains a CtvD Pfam domain at residues 516–698 and is strongly hydrophobic, consistent with a multi-pass membrane segment.
The closest reviewed homolog is Botrytis cinerea BOA8 (UniProt G0LET6), with 99.9% identity and 100% query coverage.
Reviewed homolog annotations describe a membrane-localized FAD-dependent monooxygenase involved in fungal secondary-metabolite biosynthesis.

entities.name: Botrytis BOA8
observations: UniProt G0LET6 is a reviewed FAD-dependent monooxygenase annotated as a multi-pass membrane protein.
BOA8 participates in the Botrytis cinerea botcinic acid/botcinin biosynthetic gene cluster.
GO annotations include membrane, FAD binding, and monooxygenase activity.

entities.name: Nectria ntnK
observations: UniProt A0A455M7R7 is a reviewed FAD-dependent monooxygenase with 35.2% identity and 93.1% query coverage to the query sequence.
It is annotated as a multi-pass membrane protein involved in meroterpenoid biosynthesis, including epoxidation chemistry.

entities.name: Arthrinium atnK
observations: UniProt A0A455LLW7 is a reviewed FAD-dependent monooxygenase with 32.9% identity and 94.0% query coverage to the query sequence.
It is annotated as a multi-pass membrane protein involved in arthripenoid meroterpenoid biosynthesis.
